summary: Added a support-only evidence classifier separating local benchmark improvement, transfer, fresh assurance, meta-overfit and blocking outcomes; formalized dual-source evolution from endogenous challengers and exogenous method assimilation; opened context-indexed method capability frontier as theory-only residual.
prior_art_narrowing: ADAS/Meta Agent Search: automatic agent invention and recombination are prior art
EvoAgentBench: ability-transfer framing for agent self-evolution is prior art/close neighbor
SkillFoundry: evolving validated scientific skill libraries and external resource assimilation are prior art
Red Queen Godel Machine: agent/evaluator co-evolution under controlled utilities is prior art

key_negative_controls: positive efficiency with blocking validity failure

executed_evidence_before_final_receipt.note: This execution validated the behavior/tests before later documentation/ledger commits; the exact final receipt-bearing candidate must be executed separately before promotion.

publication_claim_boundary.allowed_now: RAKL implements a governed support protocol for evaluating recursive method changes and external method assimilation.
publication_claim_boundary.not_yet_allowed: RAKL has demonstrated open-ended or universally transferable self-evolution.
publication_claim_boundary.prospective_headline: Repeated RAKL method generations produce positive gains on fresh blind assurance tasks while preserving blocking invariants and evaluator separation.

next_ai.positive: If the exact final candidate passes and is promoted, freeze prospective multi-generation development/transfer/fresh-assurance experiments before any evolution run. Separately freeze META_N093 frontier worlds before runtime implementation.
next_ai.null: If future multi-generation changes improve development but not transfer, retain LOCAL_IMPROVEMENT_ONLY and do not market the system as empirically self-evolving.
next_ai.refuted: If held-out regressions appear, preserve META_OVERFIT lineage and investigate the implicated method fiber rather than weakening assurance criteria.
next_ai.partial_id: If transfer is positive but assurance is revealed, exhausted, or evaluator independence is incomplete, report TRANSFER_OBSERVED_NOT_ASSURANCE_VALIDATED.
next_ai.blocked: Any blocking validity failure, lost negative history or failed tests blocks the evolution claim regardless of efficiency/performance gain.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before promotion, rebuild non-forced on the new head with the frozen Round-029 benchmark unchanged.
